request.style: English, joyful black gospel, powerful male lead vocal with full gospel choir call and response, Hammond organ, gospel piano, electric bass, drums, tambourine, hand claps, triumphant Easter morning, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Early on the first day at the breaking of the dawn
The women walked to see the tomb, their every hope was gone
Then the earth began to tremble and the guards became like dead men
An angel rolled the stone away and sat upon it then

[Pre-Chorus]
Do not be afraid
I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified

[Chorus]
He is not here
He has risen, just as he said
Come and see the place where he lay
He is not here
He has risen from the dead

[Verse]
Mary stood outside the tomb and wept for her lost Lord
She thought he was the gardener, till she heard a single word
He called her by her name, and Mary turned and knew his face
Rabboni, Teacher, there he stood alive in that same place

[Pre-Chorus]
Do not be afraid
I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified

[Chorus]
He is not here
He has risen, just as he said
Come and see the place where he lay
He is not here
He has risen from the dead

[Bridge]
I have seen the Lord
I have seen the Lord
Go and tell my brothers
I have seen the Lord
Filled with fear and great joy
Ran to tell his disciples

[Outro]
He has risen, just as he said
He is not here
He has risen from the dead
